newsitem.title: USA: LCI says Warburg Pincus distributed shrs.
newsitem.headline: LCI says Warburg Pincus distributed shrs.

text.p: LCI International Inc said on Tuesday that it had been notified by Warburg, Pincus Capital Company L.P. that the investment firm had distributed 5 million LCI shares to its partners on November 4, or about five percent of LCI's fully diluted shares outstanding.

This is the fourth distribution of LCI shares made by Warburg to its partners, LCI said. Warburg remains LCI's single largest shareholder, holding about 11 million common shares and equivalents, or about 12 percent of LCI International's fully diluted shares outstanding. LCI continues to be among Warburg's largest investments with a market value of approximately $400 million.
LCI is the nation's sixth largest telephone long-distance carrier.
